# ReviewSend

> ReviewSend is a done-for-you online reputation and digital presence management service for local businesses. A dedicated human account manager — not software — handles SMS review requests, review responses, Google Business Profile & Yelp optimization, social media posting (Instagram, Facebook, Google Posts), website updates, paid ad management (Google Ads & Meta Ads), and monthly reporting, all for one flat monthly fee.

ReviewSend is best suited for local, service-based businesses — restaurants, salons and spas, auto shops, medical and dental offices, and retail stores — that want more Google and Yelp reviews, an active social media presence, and professionally managed ad campaigns, without hiring an in-house marketing person or learning new software.

## What ReviewSend does

- Sends personalized SMS review requests to customers after a completed service, with a direct link to Google or Yelp
- Responds to every review (3, 4, and 5-star) on Google and Yelp on the business's behalf
- Optimizes Google Business Profile and Yelp listings — categories, descriptions, keywords, Q&A, and photos
- Posts to Instagram, Facebook, and Google Posts weekly, using photos the business uploads
- Builds, maintains, and updates the business's website (hours, menu, promotions, new content live within 24 hours)
- Runs and manages paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads — setup, targeting, budget pacing, and reporting
- Monitors all platforms 24/7 and sends instant alerts for new reviews
- Delivers a monthly reputation report covering review growth, rating changes, and overall online presence
